title: Garrecht VT-02 Mode S Transponder (Official MSFS / Asobo)
company: FlightSim Studio AG (Contracted to Asobo Studio)
summary: Engineered the authentic Garrecht VT-02 Mode S / ADS-B transponder instrument under contract from Asobo Studio for integration into official default aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator.
highlights: Simulated certified Mode A/C/S transponder with active (>1234) and standby (SBY 0022) squawk code registers.
Integrated pressure altitude encoder displaying real-time Flight Level (FL000) telemetry.
Implemented authentic green backlit dot-matrix LCD display, VFR quick-select, and IDENT pulse transmission.
